section.title: FAQ
section.description: Mail classes, proof of mailing, pricing & compliance questions.

faqs.q: What mail class do you use?
faqs.a: First-Class Mail. Marketing Mail (formerly Standard Mail) is not suitable for lien notices because it cannot include the account/personal information required for legal compliance. First-Class includes proof of mailing and is the industry standard for legal correspondence.

faqs.q: What proof of mailing do I get?
faqs.a: Every letter includes affidavit of mailing from Postalocity proving items were processed and handed to USPS. Upgrade to Certificate of Mailing for official USPS documentation or Certified Mail for full USPS tracking with delivery confirmation.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Proof of Mailing, USPS scan tracing, and Certificate of Mailing?
faqs.a: Three different things: (1) Proof of Mailing (Affidavit) documents that Postalocity processed and mailed your items. (2) USPS scan tracing shows where your letter is in the postal system — included with First-Class Mail. (3) Certificate of Mailing is an official USPS form with a post office postmark proving the EXACT DATE your letter was accepted by USPS — this is what some states require for lien deadlines. Some states require a Certificate of Mailing for lien compliance — verify with your legal counsel. The Certificate of Mailing meets legal requirements with official USPS documentation.

faqs.q: What's the difference between USPS scanning and tracking?
faqs.a: USPS scan tracing shows processing status for all mail types. For full tracking and delivery confirmation with signature, upgrade to Priority Mail or Certified Mail.
{{PRICING}} Certificate of Mailing upgrade available for additional fee.
